overclaims: Crusoe had promised all eight buildings and 1.2 GW by mid-2026, but Oracle said only about 200MW was operating on April 22, and only 42% of capacity was delivered in June.
About two months before the mid-2026 target, only about 200MW of a planned 1.2 GW was operating, by Oracle's own account.
'Massively' delayed is a judgment call; I treat 42% delivered at the target date as a large delay.
checks.note: Crusoe stated expected construction completion, not a promise of full energization. Epoch inferred 200 MW from Oracle and estimated 0.3 GW of total facility power; comparing 200 MW directly with 1.2 GW mixes measures. The 42% figure was reported June 11, not established at the target period's June 30 endpoint. Preserve these qualifications without changing the agreed mixed outcome.

The payload preserves the scope, conditional trigger and personal uncertainty. Evidence supports continued borrowing alongside tightening credit; the unmet condition is distinguished from a disproved forecast. Axis, open horizon and outcome match the agreed assessment.
